lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano stabs, shuffling percussion, sampled female voice]
(Stay, stay, I like it when you stay)

[Verse 1: soft, melodic, half sung]
Coat's on the chair and the cab's on its way
Got a flight and a thing and a million things to say
But they're playing it slow and your hand is in mine
Tell the driver go around the block and take his time

[Chorus: light beat, bass enters, female sample answers]
Stay for the slow one
Before the lights go
Got a long road, I know, I know
But give me the slow one
Hold me like you won't let go
(Stay, stay, I like it when you stay)
Stay for the slow one

[Verse 2: soft, a little lower]
Mama called, said be careful out there
City's got teeth and she said a prayer
But nothing bad ever happened in a room
Where the bass is this warm and I'm this close to you

[Chorus: light beat, bass, female sample answers]
Stay for the slow one
Before the lights go
Got a long road, I know, I know
But give me the slow one
Hold me like you won't let go
(Stay, stay, I like it when you stay)
Stay for the slow one

[Bridge: second male voice, sweeter, percussion and guitar]
Tomorrow's got a hold on us already
Tonight is only asking to go steady
Slow, slow
Don't rush it

[Final Chorus: both voices, sample layered, soft claps]
Stay for the slow one
Before the lights go
Got a long road, I know, I know
But give me the slow one
Hold me like you won't let go
(Stay, stay, I like it when you stay)
Stay for the slow one

[Outro: piano stabs and sample, a car horn outside, fade]
(I like it when you stay)
